data.text: Yes, I’ll choose 10 tons this month. That gives us agreement from all five and keeps our total at 50. For the rotation, how about this schedule, in the order John, Kate, Jack, Emma, Luke: month 2: (6, 12, 12, 10, 10); month 3: (10, 6, 12, 12, 10); month 4: (10, 10, 6, 12, 12); month 5: (12, 10, 10, 6, 12). Everyone gets the same total over five months, and each month leaves enough fish to replenish the lake. We can check the revealed catches together each month before reaffirming the next split. Luke, does that schedule work for you?
